app_fee.value: USD 65 for international applicants (USD 55 domestic); non-refundable.
app_fee.quote: The non-refundable graduate application fee is $55 for domestic applicants and $65 for international applicants.

fee_waiver.value: The Graduate Office sets no general waiver for international applicants; each department decides, so see the program record.
fee_waiver.quote: Consult your department's website to learn more about fee waiver possibilities.

gre_general.value: Set by each program; see the program record.

toefl_min.value: TOEFL iBT 80 minimum (4.5 on the new 6-point scale also accepted). Some departments ask for more.

ielts_min.value: IELTS Academic 6.5 overall minimum. Some departments ask for more.

english_waiver.value: Exemption is only for citizens of listed native-English countries; India is not listed and an English-medium degree does not count.
english_waiver.quote: Citizens of a country not listed below will still need to prove English proficiency through one of our approved means, even if the medium of academic instruction is English.

also.quote: English as a means of instruction alone

notes: Departments set deadlines, GRE and fee waivers; several ask for higher English scores than the university minimum.
